# Airocean Gases

> Airocean Gases, LLC is a U.S. supplier of ultra high purity and research grade noble and specialty gases — helium, neon, krypton, xenon, SF6, N2O, CF4 and WF6 — based in Center Valley, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2024 and a GAWDA member, it serves semiconductor, aerospace, electrical, lighting, window and research customers across North America, backed by its parent company Hongyuan's 40+ years of rare-gas production.

Contact: info@airoceangases.com · +1 302-561-2790 · 4647 Saucon Creek Road, Suite 201, Center Valley, PA 18034, USA. Pricing, minimum order and lead times are provided on request.

## Products

- [Helium (He)](https://www.airoceangases.com/product-detail-he): 5.5N (99.9995%) UHP+ and 6N (99.9999%) Research Grade; GC/GC-MS carrier gas, semiconductor, MRI, leak detection
- [Neon (Ne)](https://www.airoceangases.com/product-detail-ne): 6N Research Grade and 5.5N UHP+; excimer laser gas for lithography, lighting
- [Krypton (Kr)](https://www.airoceangases.com/product-detail-kr): Grade 5.0 (99.999%); insulated glass fill gas, KrF lasers, lighting
- [Xenon (Xe)](https://www.airoceangases.com/product-detail-xe): 5.5N UHP+ and 6N Research Grade; electric propulsion, semiconductor, medical
- [Sulfur Hexafluoride (SF6)](https://www.airoceangases.com/product-detail-sf6): 99.99% to 99.9999% electronic grade; switchgear insulation, plasma etch
- [Nitrous Oxide (N2O)](https://www.airoceangases.com/product-detail-n2o): up to 99.9995% electronic grade; PECVD oxide and oxynitride films
- [Tetrafluoromethane (CF4)](https://www.airoceangases.com/product-detail-cf4): semiconductor grade 5N; plasma etch and chamber cleaning
- [Tungsten Hexafluoride (WF6)](https://www.airoceangases.com/product-detail-wf6): up to 6N; tungsten CVD for contacts and vias
- [All products](https://www.airoceangases.com/products)
